topic: Quaternion double-cover hemisphere alignment versus 340-degree antipodal SLERP spin
topic_zh: 四元数双覆盖半球对齐与 340 度对径甩头 SLERP 对比
scope: Deterministic S³ hemisphere dot-product sign alignment, exact trigonometric SLERP vs 32-step Lie-group geodesic stepping and Node CPU solving. No SplineGS 3DGS training or neural pose diffusion.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Direct trigonometric SLERP versus 32-step incremental Lie-group power multiplication, not neural 3DGS rendering.

protocol.function: quaternion pair (q_A, q_B) → check q_A·q_B < 0 → flip q_B = -q_B (R unchanged) → shortest S³ geodesic SLERP

robustness.name: Sampled blend steps retain shortest-arc orientation under reverse visitation

not_for: Learned full-body human motion style diffusion
